book.name: 1 Timatio
book.title: Ŋwa' wvu fwe wvù Baul to saŋɛɛ ɛ̂ Timatio

content: Ɛkumɛ bonyii bo n'yɛɛyi le bo mbiay e
Keyoy ke Yuule jemyi lo teytey lɛ ɛ̀ nu ke enu kefew kemew e, ɛ́ bonyii bomew ecinɛ mbee le eyuuke wase mwɛɛm ɛ ɛ̀ nu ɛ̂ biyoy bì lɛɛle bonyii noo bon'yɛɛyi bo bonceendaa bo dɛwle le.
Ɛ bon'yɛɛyi ban nu ke etoo can bonyii bò ghane buwsee bonyii mbiayte mbiay, ɛ mvuntelem mvubole ɛ cife wase kɛ diɛwɛ bó ton ɛ ɛ̀ nu bô kento.

Bó nu ke ekane lɛ fo bonyii etaashì bvujen, bô lɛ fo wee edieè kfuu mwɛɛm mvumew kɛ. Ɛ mwɛɛm mvun nu ɛ Nyo' to fɛ lɛ bonyii edieè, ɛ bonyii bò kɛŋke mbee bvuu kee kecɛɛy dioo diee no nyaa keyoone ɛ̂ Nyo'.
Fiɛɛ ficii fì Nyo' to fɛlɛɛ nu ɛ fí jee, ɛ fimew yaa nu dvú fì wee etune ɛ́ wvú fɛn ɛ fiisɛn bô keyoone ɛ̂ Nyo' kɛ,
njefo njeme wvù wvu Nyo' bô bunle nu ɛ ge wase fí ɛ no yuule.
Waa lemme wvu Klistu Jisos wvù jee
Ɛ́ wo duŋci mwɛɛm mvun ɛ̂ boom bo bwee wesebeene le, ɛ́ wo enù wee lemme wvu Klistu Jisos wvù jee wvù nu ɛ bó ɛ kuuse bô diɛw Nyo' yì nu ɛkumɛ mbee bô n'yɛɛyi wvù jee wvù wo bii wvú le.
Fo wo ekɛŋke naa lo fiɛɛ keege bô mvumaŋgaan mvu ɛcici mvù nu sɛ mvú kɛŋke fiɛɛ keege bô Nyo' kɛ. Yɛɛyɛ ɛkolɛ kuw keecee nce ɛ ɛ̀ nu wvù Nyo' gomte.

Keedvumte ndvum yaci ye kɛŋke kɛ sɛw fô wee le. Geenɛn ɛ keecee ɛ ɛ̀ nu nce wvù Nyo' gomte kɛŋke sɛw fô wee le ɛ̂ jé le yicii, njefo fifin kɛŋke sɛw yî nshii wvu keseen e, bvuu kɛŋke yî nshii wvù too le.
Njeme wvun nu naa kecɛɛy, ɛ ɛ̀ nu njeme wvù nu ɛ kocɛn wvù wee ebee wvú le sɛ kemaŋɛn.
Ɛ̀ nɛɛ fiɛɛ fì bese famte ɛdien yî lemme din e njefo bese nu ɛ leke bvufee bvusɛse bvucii yî Nyo' wvù kɛŋke nshii le. Nyo' nu Mboyse bonyii bocii, ɛfey mvunciim bonyii bò nu ɛ bee wvú le.
Ɛ̀ yɛɛyì bonyii bô mwɛɛm mvun gayte ɛ bó gee mvú.

Fo wo ecinɛ ɛ́ wee ejoò wo ɛkuse lɛ njefo wo bɛɛ wan caan kɛ. Ɛ̀ nù kenfewsɛn fô bonyii bo mbee le ɛ̂ je yì wo jemyi jó bô yî nce wo le, noo keŋkoŋɛn kè wo kɛŋke le, noo fitele fì wo lese yî Nyo' le, noo je yì wo gɛɛle ye yo jó ɛ yí yuule le.
Nya ɛkolɛ kuw keetaaŋke Ŋwa' Nyo' ɛ̂ bonyii ya le, ebvuu efewci diɛw Nyo', eyɛɛyi tɛn bó egɛn ebuy seke me ŋke ento.
Fo wo elaŋ nnya yo kɛ. Nnya yin nu yì bó to nyaɛ ɛ̂ wo seke ŋgoo bocee bikuu bi kentaashɛ ke bonyii bo mbee le to gɛɛlɛɛ can yibo yî yo le jemyi ɛ̂ wo we diɛwɛ bonyii bo ntum Nyo' le.
Nya ɛkolɛ kuw ɛ̂ mwɛɛm mvun, egeè mvú mvunciim ɛ bonyii bocii yɛne ŋgɛnfwe wo le.
Ɛ̀ yɛnè bô ɛkolɛ kuw noo bô n'yɛɛyi wo. Ɛ̀ jici dvú ntay wvu lɛ no wo gee nonɛn, ɛ́ wo ke eboyse ɛkolɛ kuw, eboyse tɛn noo bonyii bò yuuke fiɛɛ fì wo jemyi.
